text: Figure 6.28: EventControlled Timing Class EventControlledTiming Package M2::AUTOSART emplates::SystemT emplate::Fibex::FibexCore::CoreCommunication::Timing Note Specification of a event driven sending behavior. The PDU is sent n (numberOfRepeat + 1) times separated by the repetitionPeriod. If numberOfRepeats = 0, then the Pdu is sent just once. The repetition Period is optional in case that no repetitions are configured.
